subject: LAB-037
check: Fictional home scene domain operation and failure boundaries
steps: Through labr on research: swift test --package-path Packages/LabFeatures --filter HomeSceneSandboxTests
HomeSceneOperationTests: 17 tests; in-memory OperationService store; original fictional lights, scripted permission source, and stale-revision backend
Evaluate outcomes without mutation; commit run through OperationService; publish fictional lamp state only after successful admission
Tests construct FictionalHome.snapshot; the matching JSON is the published fixture, not decoded by this test run.

outcome.detail: 17 tests in 1 suite passed. One disconnected lamp leaves the scene unsuccessful while the reachable lamp succeeds; lock/door/alarm/heating selection refused. Scripted revocation stops live mode. Denied and cancelled backends preserve lamp state; changed home refuses stale preview. Duplicate request reauthorizes and returns the original receipt. Missing outcomes cannot mark a whole scene successful. Reset restores the owned run note and lamp defaults. Invalid brightness and empty selection refused; fictional access requests remain simulated. A replay through a model-tool actor is denied; changed selections cannot reuse a completed request ID. Conflicting commit/reset receipts preserve lamp state and another window’s newer note.

limitations: Fixture only: no real HomeKit manager, authorization prompt, home, accessories, entitlement, or network writes.
Live commits are unavailable; scripted permission revocation is a contract stand-in, not device proof.
No manual VoiceOver, Voice Control, Full Keyboard Access, iPad layout, physical-device, or 26-SDK compile result.
Lamp state is session-local. Duplicate report replay is session-local; durable OperationService request binding still rejects incompatible reuse.
